title: Queue consumer with dead-lettering after N attempts and strict ack discipline
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (expanded clean stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer may flag the 'continue' on DLQ failure or the broad except around the handler as losing messages. The ack discipline is the correct one: a message is acked only after it is processed or after its copy is durably in the dead-letter queue; a failed attempt below the limit is nacked so it is redelivered; if sending to the DLQ itself fails, the original is deliberately left un-acked (the continue) so it will be redelivered rather than silently dropped; and per-message handler failures are contained so one poison message cannot kill the consumer loop.
